platform: macOS 26.5 (25F71), arm64, Apple Silicon; debug build with the embedded frontend, isolated test mode (ADR 0003, macOS amendment), WKWebView driven through the test bridge (src-tauri/src/test_bridge.rs)
harness: node scripts/macos/m1-01-04-git-review.mjs --exe <exe> --port 9431 --base <tmp> --out-dir <dir> (scripts/macos/test-instance.mjs launch(), scripts/cdp-harness.mjs IPC trace)
method: One isolated instance drove the four tickets in one conversation, in a scratch repository with local identity (git config in the repo) and local bare remotes, all under the run's temp folder. The project folder was picked from the welcome screen (folder dialog answered through dialogQueue), the first message typed with Input.insertText and sent with a real Enter (Input.dispatchKeyEvent). Panel buttons were clicked in the page (element.click()), fields filled through React's value setter, as in the Windows record. Every repository claim was read back with /usr/bin/git, independently of the UI. Each action was clicked once per pass after a Refresh, then git status/diff were polled.
limits: The stale-hunk refusal (file changed between two clicks) is covered by the Rust tests, not replayed here, as in the Windows record.
